preflight_before_training.worst_case: One approved239-token source+target example, B1. Record loss/logit comparison,184 finite gradients/deltas, frozen-base no grads, VmHWM and actual cgroup peak. No quality credit for profile weights.
preflight_before_training.gradient_control: Before full model, tiny frozen-input LoRA unit compares GC-off/on gradients and exact resume. Actual full-parent one-step control required; do not infer numeric equivalence from API availability. Serial no-GC backward reference only if root memory guard permits; otherwise explicitly scope the full-model control to no-grad forward equality plus finite GC update.
preflight_before_training.if_over_budget: Stop and preserve profile logs/partial artifacts. Do not launch150updates or silently change dtype/base/Q8/rank/batch/long examples. Root may then authorize byte-preserving build-output dedup or a separately reviewed loader-memory change; neither is authorized by this plan.
